title: Sing Aloud to God Our Strength

questions.question: Sing aloud to God our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 81:1 (ESV): "Sing aloud to God our strength; shout for joy to the God of Jacob!"

questions.question: Raise a song; sound the tambourine, the sweet lyre with the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 81:2 (ESV): "Raise a song; sound the tambourine, the sweet lyre with the harp."

questions.question: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, at the full moon, on our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 81:3 (ESV): "Blow the trumpet at the new moon, at the full moon, on our feast day."

questions.question: For it is a statute for Israel, a rule of the God of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 81:4 (ESV): "For it is a statute for Israel, a rule of the God of Jacob."

questions.question: I relieved your shoulder of the burden; your hands were freed from the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 81:6 (ESV): "I relieved your shoulder of the burden; your hands were freed from the basket."

questions.question: In distress you called, and I delivered you; I answered you in the secret place of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 81:7 (ESV): "...I answered you in the secret place of thunder;"

questions.question: I tested you at the waters of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 81:7 (ESV): "...I tested you at the waters of Meribah."

questions.question: Hear, O my people, while I admonish you! O Israel, if you would but listen to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 81:8 (ESV): "Hear, O my people, while I admonish you! O Israel, if you would but listen to me!"

questions.question: There shall be no strange god among you; you shall not bow down to a foreign what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 81:9 (ESV): "There shall be no strange god among you; you shall not bow down to a foreign god."

questions.question: I am the Lord your God, who brought you up out of the land of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 81:10 (ESV): "I am the Lord your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt."

questions.question: Open your mouth wide, and I will do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 81:10 (ESV): "Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it."

questions.question: But my people did not listen to my voice; Israel would not submit to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 81:11 (ESV): "But my people did not listen to my voice; Israel would not submit to me."

questions.question: So I gave them over to their stubborn hearts, to follow their own what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 81:12 (ESV): "So I gave them over to their stubborn hearts, to follow their own counsels."

questions.question: Oh, that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 81:13 (ESV): "Oh, that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!"

questions.question: I would soon subdue their enemies and turn my hand against their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 81:14 (ESV): "I would soon subdue their enemies and turn my hand against their foes."

key_verse_text: Sing aloud to God our strength; shout for joy to the God of Jacob!
